title: Nondeterministic termination relation
statement: For a nondeterministic register program $A$, an oracle, an input $x$, and a guard $G$ on configurations, define termination under the guard inductively as follows. Every halted configuration terminates; a live configuration terminates when it satisfies $G$ and both configurations reached by the two possible choice bits terminate.
hypotheses_covered: Program $A$ is a nondeterministic register program
An input bit string $x$ is specified
A guard $G$ on configurations is specified
